messages.subject: new paper using Stan
parts:
Hi,

I'm a co-author on a new paper using Stan. We studied chromosomal (DNA) damage in tree swallows at different sites along the Mississippi River. The multilevel model accounts for laboratory sampling at the molecular level and individual bird level to draw inferences at the site level. 

Here's the citation details:
Bigorgne, Emilie, Thomas W. Custer, Paul M. Dummer, Richard A. Erickson, Natalie Karouna-Renier, Sandra Schultz, Christine M. Custer, Wayne E. Thogmartin, and Cole W. Matson. "Chromosomal damage and EROD induction in tree swallows (Tachycineta bicolor) along the Upper Mississippi River, Minnesota, USA." Ecotoxicology (2015): 1-12.
